description: Required box volume under NEC 314.16 from your conductors, devices, clamps, fittings and grounds, checked against a standard metal box from Table 314.16(A) or your box's marked volume. Formula: Required volume = Σ(conductors × Table 314.16(B) allowance) + 1 allowance for clamps + 1 per fitting type + 2 per yoke + 1 for all grounds, each at the largest conductor size present. Allowances: 18 AWG 1.50, 16 AWG 1.75, 14 AWG 2.00, 12 AWG 2.25, 10 AWG 2.50, 8 AWG 3.00, 6 AWG 5.00 cu in.

clamps.description: Internal cable clamps; default 0; one of 0 = None, 1 = Yes (one or more)

grounds.description: Equipment grounding conductors; default 1; one of 1 = Yes (one or more), 0 = None

title: Electrical Box Fill Calculator (NEC 314.16)
